policies.name: LabOperators
statements: Allow group LabAdmins to manage all-resources in tenancy
Allow group LabReaders to read instances in compartment Sandbox
Allow dynamic-group BatchWorkers to use object-family in compartment LabData
Allow group ScopedOps to manage instances in compartment Sandbox where request.permission='INSTANCE_CREATE'

policies.name: AuditReaders
statements: Allow group Reviewers to inspect instances in compartment Sandbox
